title: Uniformly heated long cylinder: parabolic temperature and thermal stress (analytic)
description:
Quarter cross-section of a long solid rod (radius b, plane strain) with a uniform heat source q, its surface held at T_amb by a fixed-temperature shell around it (the shell conducts heat but has no stiffness: a void for the solid). heat_solid_thermal_strain hands T - T_amb to the solid; rollers on x_lo / y_lo are the symmetry lines, the rod surface is free.
Analytic: theta = T - T_amb = q (b^2 - r^2) / (4 k); with C = E alpha q / (16 k (1 - nu)): sigma_r = -C (b^2 - r^2), sigma_theta = -C (b^2 - 3 r^2), so in Cartesian form sigma_xx = -C (b^2 - x^2 - 3 y^2), sigma_yy = -C (b^2 - 3 x^2 - y^2); sigma_zz = nu (sigma_xx + sigma_yy) - E alpha theta; u_r = (1 + nu) alpha / (1 - nu) * theta0 r (3 - 2 nu - r^2 / b^2) / 4 with theta0 = q b^2 / (4 k) (from u_r = (1 + nu)/(1 - nu) alpha / r * int_0^r theta r dr + C1 r and sigma_r(b) = 0); u_r peaks inside the rod, at r^2 = (3 - 2 nu) b^2 / 3 (r ~0.894 b), ~2 % above its surface value.
The held shell's temperature sits on its faces toward the rod (the staircase surface, on r = b along the axes), so the bare formula applies: no half-cell wall offset.
Line profile tab: T_radial (heat.T), sigma_r (solid.stress_xx), sigma_theta (solid.stress_yy), sigma_z (solid.stress_zz) and u_radial (solid.u_x) along the line half a cell above the x axis, centre to the last rod cell; errors relative to each curve's range: T and u_x well below 1 %, the stresses ~1-2 % (the rod edge is a staircase of 64 cells per radius; the outermost cell or two scatter more).
Derived values tab: dT_centre, sxx_centre / syy_centre (-C b^2 = -6.25 MPa), szz_centre and ux_peak (max u_x, the interior peak of u_r) with their references (~0.2 % or better).

parameters.description: Young's modulus of the rod in Pa

parameters.name: alpha_rod
parameters.description: thermal expansion coefficient of the rod in 1/K

parameters.name: T_amb
parameters.description: surface (shell) temperature = heat T0 = stress-free temperature in K

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (64 cells per radius)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: side of the quarter model (rod plus an 8-cell held shell)

parameters.description: analytic centre rise in K (25 K)

parameters.name: C_stress
parameters.description: thermal stress coefficient C in Pa/m^2 (C b^2 = 6.25 MPa)
